plan.description: Freeze synthetic well identities, partition volume, controls, scaling, exact intervals and replicate agreement before counts.
Admit immutable synthetic counts and preserve integer-count, identity, NTC and partition QC failures.
Compute Poisson concentrations and exact transformed binomial intervals; pool only concordant passing wells.
Retain all wells, samples, failed controls and unavailable values with sample denominators.
Register ordinary artifacts and separate bounded claims for coordinator-owned independent review.
